ddl.name: attempt_deadline
ddl.value: ("expires_at" is null or "expires_at" > "started_at") and ("mode" <> 'strict_mock' or "expires_at" is not null)

ddl.name: active_profile_verified
ddl.value: not "active" or ("source_url" is not null and "source_title" is not null and "verified_at" is not null and "reviewer_id" is not null)

ddl.name: lesson_review_gate
ddl.value: "status" not in ('published','reviewed') or ("reviewed_by" is not null and "reviewed_at" is not null)

ddl.name: question_review_gate
ddl.value: "status" not in ('published','reviewed') or ("reviewed_by" is not null and "reviewed_at" is not null and length(trim("explanation")) > 0)
